no_science_change: coefficients and dispersion (model files byte-identical to v1.0)
model.py / data.py / compare.py / quality.py / acquire.py byte-identical to v1.0

issue_1_decision_key.flaw: Ledger.keys() collapsed decision uniqueness to (game_id, horizon); a revised NHL start would have been silently suppressed.

revision_rules.A: start changes before the old cutoff and before any forecast exists: the newly observed schedule is used (the old key never produced a row)
revision_rules.B: an existing forecast is preserved byte-for-byte; a revised start that creates a new cutoff is a NEW decision key with its own window
revision_rules.C: a revised cutoff already passed when first observed: MISSED_REVISED_CUTOFF (when the ledger already holds a row for the same game and horizon under a different start), otherwise MISSED_CUTOFF; never backfilled
revision_rules.D: postponed or cancelled (gameScheduleState != OK): no forecast is generated; existing forecasts stay in RAW history; a DECISION_STATE row records POSTPONED_OR_CANCELLED_OBSERVED or SCHEDULE_REVISED
revision_rules.grading_linkage: a forecast is graded only against a final game whose official startTimeUTC equals the forecast's scheduled_start; otherwise an UNGRADED row (SCHEDULE_START_CHANGED_NO_LINKAGE or POSTPONED_OR_CANCELLED) is written; no linkage across a revision is defined

issue_2_source_provenance.format: per-run immutable run_source_manifest, content-addressed at phase1a_sog_forward/manifests/<manifest_sha256>.json; every ledger row references source_manifest_sha256; raw bytes stay content-addressed gz blobs
issue_2_source_provenance.audit_guarantee: audit_ledger() proves for every forecast row that every predictive source in its manifest has completeness COMPLETE, a stored blob whose sha256 matches, and retrieval_completed_utc <= the row's cutoff_at

issue_3_completeness_gate.rule: if any required predictive source is incomplete, truncated, malformed or fails to fetch, NO normal forecast is generated for any decision of that run
integrity_rules: stats response: reported_total < 10000 and returned_rows == reported_total
assembly invariants (no duplicate rows, participants of the scheduled game)
every game with state OFF/FINAL and start <= run time - 210 min must have player rows for both teams

statuses.SOURCE_INCOMPLETE_NO_FORECAST: guard, parse, assembly or missing-game failure
statuses.SOURCE_FETCH_FAILED_NO_FORECAST: fetch exception after the fetcher's own retries
statuses.MISSED_CUTOFF: no valid forecast inside the window
statuses.INVALID_LATE: retrieval or generation completed after the cutoff

model_identity_proof_required: T24H/T90/T30 model files byte-identical to v1.0 (sha256)
NB dispersion, feature order and preprocessing equal
comparator constants, base rates and meaningful rule equal in the v1.1 lock
clock_rule: the first committed FORECAST row must come from real wall-clock time inside its registered 15-minute window; no simulated clock, no throwaway real-data forecast as evidence
no_automation_claim: no background process is claimed to guarantee capture; the workflow is manual-dispatch only; windows nobody executes are recorded MISSED_CUTOFF later
